title: Finance API Accounting Activities endpoints decommissioned
summary: On 2026-05-04 Xero decommissioned the Finance API's Accounting Activities API: Account Usage, Lock History, Report History and User Activities. All of these endpoints now return errors. Xero suggests the Bank Statements API for cash flow and financial analysis.
migrationNote: Remove calls to /finance.xro/1.0/AccountingActivities/AccountUsage, LockHistory, ReportHistory and UserActivities, along with the features built on them. For cash-flow or transaction analysis, move to the Finance API Bank Statements endpoint (/finance.xro/1.0/BankStatementsPlus/statements). Lock history and user activity data have no direct replacement.

provenance.quote: Finance API - We decommissioned the Accounting Activities API. The Accounting Activities API-which included Account Usage, Lock History, Report History, and User Activities endpoints-was retired. For cash flow and financial analysis needs, we recommend using our Bank Statements API as an alternative solution. All Accounting Activities endpoints will now return errors.
